entities.name: Kequia Akosa
entities.description: A young human psychometrist from Femeref, daughter of Niambi, recruited to Strixhaven as an ember.

entities.name: Femeref
entities.description: Region of Dominaria where Kequia was born.

entities.name: Lorehold
entities.description: College of history and archeology Kequia hopes to join.

entities.name: Professor Kasmina
entities.description: Professor who recruited the five students to steal their sparks.

entities.name: Jamira
entities.description: Minotaur classmate whom Kequia falls in love with.

entities.name: Desparkening
entities.description: Event that may have affected Kequia's potential.

events.summary: Professor Kasmina recruits Kequia for Strixhaven because she is an ember.
events.quote: Kequia was recruited for Strixhaven by Professor Kasmina

events.summary: Kequia forms a class with Eula Blue, Segante, Alandra and Jamira.
events.quote: Kequia formed a class with the ambitious Eula Blue

events.summary: Kequia falls in love with Jamira while Kasmina secretly sows tension.
events.quote: This didn't prevent her from falling in love with Jamira.

events.summary: Kasmina's plot to force the students to ignite and steal their sparks is revealed and thwarted; Kasmina presumably dies.
events.quote: This plot was thwarted by the five students combining their powers

events.summary: Professor Vess lets the students stay and pledge to their colleges, as residential advisors.
events.quote: She allowed them to stay on and pledge to their individual colleges

relations.quote: Kequia Akosa is the daughter of Niambi
to rob their sparks to reignite her own
